tableContracts.prf_per004_artifact_preparations: One CAS-governed PREPARED, FINALIZED or QUARANTINED handshake row per tenant, configurationId and Platform create subject/action/idempotency identity. It binds request digest, owner-local artifact revision, canonical artifact UUID, schema key/version, payload reference/digest, scope digest and one preparation receipt. Exact replay returns the same fact; a different request digest fails closed. QUARANTINED requires exact signed ABSENT_FINAL evidence under the Platform durable admission fence; UNKNOWN, timeout, in-flight or unfenced absence remains PREPARED.
tableContracts.prf_per004_configuration_version_binding: Exactly one immutable finalized binding per tenant, configurationId and Platform version and exactly one finalized binding per artifact public UUID. It stores the complete trusted binding tuple, exact preparation and finalization receipt identities and Platform create receipt reference. UPDATE, DELETE and TRUNCATE are rejected.
tableContracts.prf_per004_owner_evidence_receipts: Append-only VALIDATION or SIMULATION evidence bound to one finalized tuple. SIMULATION references the exact VALIDATION receipt and immutable impact digest. Duplicate, conflicting, cross-tenant, stale or tuple-mismatched evidence is rejected. UPDATE, DELETE and TRUNCATE are rejected.

artifactIdentity.referenceRule: The UUID suffix must equal the stored artifact public ID byte-for-byte after canonical lowercase UUID normalization; browser-authored references or digests are forbidden.
artifactIdentity.artifactRevisionRule: artifact_revision is owner-local and monotonic. It is independent from the later Platform configuration version.

rowLevelSecurityClaims.rule: The three new tables must ENABLE and FORCE RLS with USING and WITH CHECK tenant policies bound to the existing Performance tenant context. The existing V17 artifact table retains ENABLE and FORCE RLS. No RLS claim is made for any other reused table.

reservationSemantics: This append-only artifact supersedes only the inactive Batch-02 PER-002 V19 candidate and reserves Performance V19 plus the exact PER-004 path. It is not an active lease and grants no migration write, source write, test, commit or push authority. A later append-only active-lease successor must hash-bind a materialized clean backend worktree, and a separate executable start token must bind that successor and the owner packet.
invalidationConditions: Performance V19 or the exact leased path exists from another owner before the first authorized edit.

The planned backend worktree path or branch exists with a different head, tree, upstream or non-empty porcelain.
Any table, existing-table alteration, backfill, grant or schema change outside the resolved exact manifest is required.
